Mark of the Patron.name: Mark of the Patron
Mark of the Patron.description:
Those that serve patrons are already known for binding themselves to the powers that be in strange ways, but some choose a different path. Patrons of these witches mark them for power, literally, granting them a visible manifestation of their patrons power. Such witches need not bother with conduits or messengers, they commune directly with the patron in a land of parley, a shared realm within the mind's eye that is made by agreed construction between witch and patron. The hexmarked know no world without a constant connection to their benefactor, though such a connection is not without its own secrets.

Even though most patrons send a literal messenger in the role of a familiar, your patron has instead chosen to mark you as their own in inducting you into its service by way of a hexmark. You gain the Mark of the Patron. Your mark might be a scar, flowered hair, a horned shadow, or a simple tattoo, but no matter its form it serves as the binding to your patron.

You can communicate with your patron by interacting with your mark. Your patron can also communicate with you, which it does by altering the mark's form, whispering within your mind, or sending you brief visions, though it can only convey vague messages with you when it does so in this way. If you choose @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-journals.JournalEntry.qgxQMdRUrBVZeNv5.JournalEntryPage.qoCviKsTtdPLiXYi]{this class archetype}, you must select  @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-feats.Item.OWLoQyaiccx31RUv]{Hexmarked Witch Dedication} as your 2nd-level class feat.

Hexmarked Witch Adjustments

You do not gain a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.yksPhweBZYVCsE1A]{familiar} or additional familiar abilities at 6th, 12th, and 18th level. You do not learn @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aq1yonHeYpbaj3XI]{Patron's Puppet} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rMOI8JFJ0nT2mrCF]{Phase Familiar} as a hex spell at level 1 and instead learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YVK3JUkPVzHIeGXQ]{Cackle} hex spell. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.7QcvUZh4dPjP8r3K]{Mark of Mystery} hex cantrip and at 12th level, you gain a basic, greater, or major lesson of your choice. You must select the Hexmarked Witch Dedication as your 2nd-level class feat. If you select Charisma as your key attribute, your spell attack modifier and spell DC use your Charisma modifier instead of your Intelligence modifier.

You gain a mark from your patron that is difficult for you to hide, requiring you to use either Stealth or Deception to prevent others from noticing its presence. Creatures that see your mark can recognize your mark by succeeding at a Recall Knowledge appropriate for your magical tradition. The Stealth, Deception, and Recall Knowledge checks use your spell DC to determine the results. Creatures that succeed are aware of your spellcasting tradition in addition to the normal results and may treat you differently depending on how they regard those with your patron's mark.

Your mark serves as your familiar for the purposes of the special familiar ability associated with your patron and for feats that would normally use your familiar. When you Cast or Sustain a hex, you use your position or the position of your mark for the purposes of determining the effect, your choice at the time you Cast or Sustain a hex.

You can choose feats that would grant your familiar special actions or abilities, gaining the action yourself instead of the familiar and applying the effects using your mark instead of a familiar. You cannot, however, select feats that would require a familiar for them to function at all (subject to GM discretion).

For instance, you could select the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.FCivW0HZhm7PoxrC]{Spirit Familiar} class feat, gaining the action yourself and having your mark complete the activity normally taken by your familiar, but you could not select @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.N7dTFxpjXGn4ddq8]{Enhanced Familiar} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gKoNWXem1ikEqE2d]{Familiar's Language}, since both of the effects of those feats rely on your familiar being a creature.

Special If your patron is the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.FdLx4VODZEYLGOK9]{The Inscribed One}, you increase your reach by 5 feet for the purposes of determining flanking when you Cast or Sustain a hex.

Familiar Superstition.name: Familiar Superstition
Familiar Superstition.description:
Choosing a Superstition

Your superstition is based on unusual traits your familiar has—a conclusion drawn from the way they act, not vice versa. For example, a witch might see that their familiar resembles a flying eyeball and notice that it seems preoccupied with knowledge of the old ways before remembering old tales of ancient scholars with similar minions, this granting you the superstition of It Is Ever-Learning. From here, this witch would study magics that specifically link to these stories, and in turn their familiar. You cannot select more than one superstition, and they are chosen at level 1.

If your superstition would grant a familiar ability that your familiar already has naturally, you may select a replacement familiar ability instead of the one you would have gained. If you gain a specific familiar, you must have enough familiar abilities without including your superstition familiar abilities unless that specific familiar already possesses the familiar ability your superstition would grant.

Advanced Superstition

Your studies of your familiar have given you greater insight into their abilities. When you become 12th level, you gain the Advanced Superstition instead of the additional familiar ability you would receive at 12th level.

Shared Realm.name: Shared Realm
Shared Realm.description:
You and your patron can form a stronger means of contact when you tap into the powers of your mark to enter a shared realm, which you access through careful concentration. This shared realm exists in your mind's eye and serves as an intermediary location where you communicate with your patron. This shared realm is usually the same location every time, though both you and your patron possess the ability to manipulate the space and the realm may change between visits.

The shared realm of a starless shadow might be under an unlit sky at night, an inscribed one witch might be an ancient library with winding book shelves, and a silence in snow witch might be among the frozen halls in a castle made of ice. Whatever form your shared realm takes, you access it by spending 10 minutes to concentrate much the same way other witches commune with their familiar. When you access your shared realm, you project a mental image of yourself to the location but your body remains in the real world and you remain aware of your surroundings in the real world. If something would break your concentration or otherwise prevent you from concentrating to access your shared realm, your mental image is expelled from your shared realm and you cannot enter again until you spend 10 minutes concentrating.

Your shared realm serves as a repository for your spells your patron has bestowed to you, and you enter your shared realm to prepare your spells each day using your witch spellcasting. You have the same number of spells as a witch does with a familiar except your shared realm gains these spells.

Each time you gain a level, your patron grants two new spells of any level you can cast to your shared realm, chosen from common spells of your tradition or others you gain access to. Feats or abilities that would normally grant your familiar spells instead grant your shared realm spells.

You can learn new spells independently of your patron by adding them to your shared realm. You can add any spell on your tradition's spell list to your shared realm by offering the scroll of that spell to your patron via your shared realm, a process that takes 1 hour. You can use the Learn a Spell exploration activity to prepare a special written version of a spell in your shared realm, which you can then add to your shared realm.

Hexmarked Witch Extra Lesson.name: Hexmarked Witch Extra Lesson
Hexmarked Witch Extra Lesson.description: You gain a basic, greater, or major lesson of your choice.
